title: 散文 9
content:
MY LOVE
There's a girl who I love,
I think I'll find her, get her and pray that we stay forever together and rise above the pettyness of lying and watch her lay.
Her name is Tammy, a girl that'll be true to me in every way imaginable
as we found eachother again, which happens few as together we did what was thought impossible.
This is the story about my love Tammy,she and I will have good times to come
as she finally realised how much she loved me and found me again with people - some.
A question of time, patience,loyalty, trust and of course the most important - LOVE that probed throughout cyberspace's radiance and touching all with thier sweet velvet glove.
Returning back is the greatest of all,to see her face, to hear her voice, to touch her hand is to be my greatest positive judgement call as together in the grass playing we will fall.
